mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message ( conversation_id, source_type, source_id, source_title, source_desc, target_url, conversation_title, conversation_avatar, sender_id, sender_name, sender_avatar, content, message_type, is_deleted, create_time ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceTitle}, #{sourceDesc}, #{targetUrl}, #{conversationTitle}, #{conversationAvatar}, #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{senderAvatar}, #{content}, #{messageType}, 0, #{createTime} )
mapper.select:
SELECT cm.conversation_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.conversation_title, ''), '消息对话') AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.conversation_avatar, ''), cm.sender_avatar, '') AS avatar, cm.content AS lastMsg, cm.create_time AS lastTime, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM chat_message unread_msg LEFT JOIN chat_conversation_read read_state ON read_state.conversation_id = unread_msg.conversation_id AND read_state.user_id = #{userId} WHERE unread_msg.conversation_id = cm.conversation_id AND unread_msg.is_deleted = 0 AND unread_msg.sender_id <> #{userId} AND (read_state.last_read_time IS NULL OR unread_msg.create_time > read_state.last_read_time) ) AS unread, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.source_type, ''), 'chat') AS type, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.source_type, ''), 'chat') AS sourceType, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.source_id, ''), cm.conversation_id) AS sourceId, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.source_title, ''), '') AS sourceTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.source_desc, ''), '') AS sourceDesc, COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.target_url, ''), '') AS targetUrl FROM chat_message cm INNER JOIN ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM chat_message WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND (conversation_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%') OR sender_id = #{userId} OR source_id = #{userId})
GROUP BY conversation_id ) latest ON latest.max_id = cm.id WHERE cm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC, cm.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversation_read (conversation_id, user_id, last_read_time) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_time = VALUES(last_read_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT cm.conversation_id AS id, MAX(cm.create_time) AS lastTime, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cm.sender_id ORDER BY cm.sender_id SEPARATOR ',') AS participants FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY cm.conversation_id
SELECT DISTINCT conversation_id FROM chat_message WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND conversation_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
